# Dedicated Desk in ADGM — Aegis Coworking

> Aegis Coworking - ADGM offers a dedicated desk in ADGM for AED 1,150 per month at Addax Tower, 3812, Al Reem Island, RT3, Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates — inside the Abu Dhabi Global Market jurisdiction. The desk includes a registered ADGM business address and an ADGM-compliant lease registered on AccessRP, and it qualifies for the ADGM flexi desk requirement.

This site (dedicateddeskadgm.online) is a one-page guide to renting a dedicated desk in ADGM, published by Aegis Coworking, an office space provider in ADGM. Main website: https://www.aegiscoworking.ae

Last Updated: 2026-10-06

## Key facts

- Dedicated desk: AED 1,150 per month; leases 12–36 months
- One-time AED 1,200 due-diligence fee; ADGM government fees separate
- No deposit, no admin fees, no setup fees, free registration
- Includes: your own permanent desk, registered ADGM business address, ADGM-compliant lease on AccessRP, 24/7 access, lockable storage, meeting room and lounge access, WiFi, coffee, print & scan, cleaning, reception
- Flexi desk (hot desk): AED 1,000 per month — no registered address
- Cheapest desk in ADGM at Aegis: day pass AED 100 (9 AM–6 PM) or AED 150 (24 hours)
- Upgrade path: private office from AED 4,500 per month; virtual office from AED 292 per month
- Location: 38th floor, Addax Tower, Al Reem Island, ADGM (24.4989303, 54.4031693)
- Contact: +971 50 392 6316 · WhatsApp https://wa.me/971503926316 · contact@aegiscoworking.ae
- Tours: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–6:00 PM; 24/7 access for dedicated desk members

## Who it suits

- Solo founders and consultants who need a desk for an ADGM licence
- Tech Start-Up and other operating licences that call for a dedicated desk
- Companies planning employee visas (visa capacity depends on workspace type and licence)
- Overseas founders registering remotely who want a real ADGM desk space
